content.value: Create a user defined data type called “student" using structure containing first name, last name, roll, and cgpa. Then, declare an array of 50 students of type "student",. A file named "input.txt" has 50 lines where each line contains the above information of a student. Now put these data into the array and find the highest and average cgpa of the students and print these to console.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
